**What / why**
The effect or capability you want, and the editing look it enables.

**Reference**
Link/clip of the style (e.g. one of the 9 fan-edit styles), or a Remotion mock.

**Additive check**
Confirm this is additive and does not involve unlocking paid/Pro features. ✅ / ❌
